# Device State Console v3.0.175

## Headless and Go Agent performance

- Consolidate the collector into an in-process goroutine inside `guanlan-agent` (`windows-agent-backend`) by default and apply conservative Go runtime memory limits (`GOGC=50`, `GOMEMLIMIT=32MiB` when unset), eliminating duplicate runtime memory in headless and machine-service modes.
- Replace periodic Windows PowerShell / `netsh` probe subprocesses with persistent native Win32 PDH queries, logical drive APIs, processor topology APIs, and `wlanapi.dll` Wi-Fi signal probes; cache static CPU topology across samples.
- Run LibreHardwareMonitor through a lazy, single-instance, below-normal-priority worker with post-sample working-set trimming and idle shutdown, trim unused GUI/plotting/scheduler assemblies from the bundled LHM assets (-54%), and avoid registering duplicate scheduled sensor tasks when installed as a Windows service.

## Agent-to-Hub transport and incremental queries

- Support gzip request/response compression on `/api/agent/ingest` and Hub JSON endpoints, backed by pooled compressors and bounded HTTP keep-alive connections.
- Deduplicate unchanged static hardware inventory fields across consecutive Agent reports via `inventoryHash` / `inventoryOmitted` with automatic full-inventory recovery (`needInventory`) after Hub restarts.
- Switch trusted realtime inspection (`live`) to on-demand WebSocket activation piggybacked on `/api/agent/ingest` (`liveWanted`), keeping zero idle WebSockets in standby and disconnecting cleanly after 3 minutes of inactivity while remaining compatible with older Hubs.
- Add conditional `ETag` / `304 Not Modified` caching on `/api/devices` and `/api/instances` and incremental `?since=` series fetching on raw `1m`/`5m` metric windows.

## Desktop memory, IPC efficiency, Linux packaging, and documentation

- Reclaim hidden-to-tray Electron `BrowserWindow` renderer/GPU processes after 30 seconds and recreate the window seamlessly from the in-memory snapshot when reopened.
- Coalesce background live refresh notifications, deduplicate redundant IPC snapshot deliveries in the shared console workspace, defer disk cache deep-cloning/serialization until flush, and gate manual update checks to explicit user refresh actions.
- Move Linux `.deb` GUI shared libraries from hard `Depends` to `Recommends` so headless servers can install cleanly with `apt install --no-install-recommends`.
- Rewrite the user-facing `README.md`, move historical release notes under `.github/release-notes/`, and upgrade the official website observatory rendering and fleet/realtime/external-DB documentation.

## Validation

- Source and package versions are synchronized at 3.0.175.
- Full unit, race, contract, packaging, headless service, and visual validation gates run across Linux, Windows, macOS, Web, and Android in GitHub Actions.

This is the formal stable release for v3.0.175.
